item.title: Sleep Debt: Combatting Social Jet Lag for Better Health
item.description: Sleep debt is a critical issue affecting many, particularly from their mid-teens to working ages. As a result, complaints of daytime sleepiness and decreased concentration have become increasingly common. Underlying these issues are conditions known as “sleep debt” and “social jet lag.” Every individual has a distinct amount of necessary sleep. item.title: Buddhism’s Teachings on the Bigger Picture: How to Balance Personal Gains
item.description: In exploring Buddhism’s teachings, one crucial concept is about the relationship between personal (small) and societal (big) benefits. This notion becomes especially pertinent when individual interests conflict with broader community goals. For instance, when an individual makes a choice that advances personal gain, it can often come at the expense of another party.
